label: Basic blocks
subgoals: Start a new block at every branch target and every join
End a block at each condition test
Add the blocks contributed by each if, if-else and while

label: Edges
subgoals: Draw the two edges out of every condition test
Connect the end of each arm or body to its join or header
Mark the back edge of each loop

label: Cyclomatic complexity
subgoals: Compute E minus N plus 2 for the graph
Check the result against the number of decisions plus one
Relate the complexity to test paths and multiplexer depth
